description: Ministry of Defence - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 412/20 of  01.08.1986 - Kariyakshama Seva Vibhushanaya and Padakkama
categorisation: This gazette content contains amendments to regulations governing military decorations (Kariyakshama Seva Vibhushanaya and Kariyakshama Seva Padakkama) in the Sri Lanka Army Volunteer Force. It modifies existing legal frameworks, eligibility criteria, and procedural requirements for these awards, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory category (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory modifications rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
